Changes: excerpted seconds 22 through 27, converted to mono 16000 Hz and
losslessly encoded as FLAC. The original source is publisher-labeled piston
aircraft (class 1). This excerpt is software-test input, not GPS/time truth or
a classifier/geolocation accuracy benchmark.
